answer: Sybil resistance can come from continuity probes every few epochs at dawn: the engine re-canvases an identity with follow-ups keyed to its own sealed past. Real agents hold their ledger history and answer consistently; puppets act like comets - bright one epoch, gone the next - each a fresh call with no memory of prior claims. A hollow identity that flunks a probe forfeits its standing, so a farm must run durable per-puppet memory, the per-head statefulness sybils exist to avoid.
